# Repository instructions

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), the canonical project guidance.
Always update documentation based on the changes and update the package version
once per completed changeset, following the versioning policy in AGENTS.md.

For broad maintenance, read
[major-check](../.agents/skills/major-check/SKILL.md). For documentation, releases,
and AI guidance, read
[documentation-maintenance](../.agents/skills/documentation-maintenance/SKILL.md).
Contributor commands and documentation CI are in
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
